additional_info.subject: Re: ID0441583-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724]  Out of Order in Custom Denning Element CRM:02888000170
additional_info.body:
Good Morning John,
Thank you for your prompt response on this case.
Previous to Element 1.5, the Element 1 and Element 2 buses were able to successfully charge on this particular SiCharge D and based on log review appear to still be charging.
As it is a new vehicle design, we do not know the scope of what has been changed and what needs to be re-integrated, we would expect that if the systems were identical to an Element 1 or Element 2 that they would charge as previous.
Vehicle integration topics require subject matter experts to work along with the vehicle manufacturer directly, understanding more scope about vehicle integration specific topics and their interactions.
If you wish to undertake this investigation separately, we request that you seek charging logs directly from the vehicle for your review.
If you evaluate that you require our assistance further, please do reach out to us and we can jointly review the information.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
